# RetainOS

RetainOS is a dental practice patient retention platform that replaces 6 separate tools (recall automation, loyalty program, patient portal, review generator, payment terminal, analytics, and automated aftercare) with one branded patient app.

## Who it's for

- Solo dental practices
- Multi-location dental groups
- Dental Service Organizations (DSOs)

## Core features

- **White-label patient app** — Custom-branded PWA for iOS and Android, no app store submission needed
- **Recall automation** — Multi-channel (SMS, push, email) automated sequences to bring patients back
- **Loyalty engine** — Points, tiers (Silver/Gold/Platinum), and household family pooling
- **Review collection** — Post-visit automated review requests to grow Google rating
- **Payment collection** — In-app card-on-file payments reducing outstanding balances
- **Analytics dashboard** — Real-time retention metrics, churn prediction, VIP alerts
- **Aftercare checklists** — Automated procedure-specific aftercare follow-ups via text/email
- **Social post generator** — AI-powered branded social media content templates

## Integrations

- Dentrix
- Eaglesoft
- Open Dental
- More PMS integrations available on Enterprise plans

## Pricing

- Starter: $299/month per location
- Growth: $599/month per location
- Enterprise: Custom pricing for DSOs and multi-location groups
- Free 14-day trial available (no credit card required)
